camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore TransformToPrePaid --region cn-hangzhou --AutoRenewPeriod 3 --CouponNo 'example-string' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --AutoRenew false --Period 12 --AutoPay true
description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis-compatible) instance to the subscription billing method
description_zh: 将按量付费的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore transform-to-pre-paid --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --period 12 --auto-pay true --auto-renew false --auto-renew-period 3 --coupon-no example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformToPrePaid

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh: 预付费时长，单位为月。取值：1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment. Valid values:

true: Automatically completes the payment.

false (default): An order is generated, but is not automatically paid. You must then log on to the console to pay for the order. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付款，取值：
true：自动付款。
false：手动付款（默认），您通过控制台对实例进行手动续费，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required if AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。

当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period
